name: API Orchestrator - Monitoring
description: Real-time monitoring dashboard with live metrics, an activity heatmap, and a live request feed.
project_description: API Orchestrator - Monitoring provides a real-time monitoring dashboard for API Orchestrator. MonitoringController exposes AJAX JSON endpoints for realtime metrics, a day/hour activity heatmap, and a live recent-request feed, backed by parameterized aggregate SQL over the api_orchestrator_request table and rendered via an SDC component with polling JavaScript. Requires api_orchestrator. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
